rv.q: The score moves through folk, ballads and choral numbers; fans will recognise songs like Island of Souls, All This Time and When We Dance. Sting’s presence is a clear drawcard for the 1,500-strong audience. He brings a rugged authenticity to the role, though his performance is more understated than some of his castmates.

In the style of a pop concert, four shadowy figures pose to the pulse of techno beats mixed with options from the UK census. “White, Black, Asian, Mixed,” it says – Latinx is notably absent. Then comes a clash of identities inside what looks like a giant hairband.
